cases.reply: Advanced Python (PY202) requires basic programming knowledge. Someone with no programming experience should first consider an introductory course rather than assume they meet this prerequisite.

A refund is permitted only when BOTH conditions are satisfied: the refund request is made within seven days of payment, AND the learner has not attended the first class. Both conditions must be checked together; satisfying only one is insufficient.

Attendance at the first class makes the request ineligible under this policy, even if it is within seven days of payment.
